root_cause: LinkedIn setup treated multiple active Composio connections as an ambiguity instead of probing for a healthy canonical identity.
The personal no-gap pool permanently excluded previously used source IDs, so the verified personal source pool could become empty even though reusable verified non-sensitive facts existed.
prevention: Probe all active LinkedIn Composio connections and select the one that proves the canonical LinkedIn member; ignore revoked siblings.
Only require user re-auth when no active canonical connection is healthy.
Keep one five-minute closed-loop scheduler as the sole social delivery owner.
When unused personal sources are exhausted, rotate the least-recently-used verified non-sensitive source and require a fully new angle/copy.
Never use Buffer or invented personal facts as recovery.
